class.description: DOD NOTE: ControlStickDeadzoneVisualizer renders a hardware-agnostic 2D telemetry and response-curve plot for `GameplayControlMap` using immediate-mode `CanvasItem` primitives (`_notification(NOTIFICATION_DRAW)`), avoiding child `Control` node bloat. It visualizes: 1. Left Stick Gate: Outer unit circle, `left_stick_deadzone_outer` ring, shaded `left_stick_deadzone_inner` zone (radial circle or axial crossband), raw input deflection dot, and filtered output deflection vector. 2. Deadzone & Response Curve Plot: Maps input magnitude [0..1] -> output strength [0..1] across `DEADZONE_RADIAL_SCALED`, `DEADZONE_AXIAL_INDEPENDENT`, and `DEADZONE_CUBIC_PRECISION` combined with `gamepad_response_exponent`. 3. Right Stick Gate & L2/R2 Analog Trigger Bars: Displays `right_stick_deadzone_inner`/`outer` and vertical trigger meters with `trigger_deadzone` threshold markers. Part of IdeamGames (game agents, players, rules, scoring, and match orchestration).
